Configure liter-llm to extract text with a vision-capable model

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val input = mapper.readValue("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"image/png\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png\"}", ExtractInput::class.java)
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"force_ocr\":true,\"ocr\":{\"backend\":\"vlm\",\"enabled\":true,\"language\":[\"eng\"],\"vlm_config\":{\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o-mini\",\"temperature\":0.0}},\"url\":{\"crawl\":{\"ssrf\":{}}}}", ExtractionConfig::class.java)
    val result = Xberg.extract(input, config)
    println(result.results.first().content)
}
```
